# Минулий час

> [!quiz] I ___ at home yesterday.
> level: A2 · id: en-a2-past-q01
> - [x] was
> - [ ] am

> [!quiz] They ___ happy.
> level: A2 · id: en-a2-past-q02
> - [x] were
> - [ ] was

> [!listen] Що ти почув?
> level: A2 · id: en-a2-past-l01
